items.a: Yallacademy is a cloud platform that sports academies use to run their whole operation: branches, coaches, trainees, training groups, schedules, attendance, subscriptions, receipts, coach payroll, and income and expenses for every branch. Owners, moderators, coaches and parents each get their own access. It works in Arabic and English and supports any sport.
Any sport taught in groups or sessions: football, swimming, tennis, gymnastics, martial arts, basketball and more. Each academy sets up its own groups, levels and schedules.
Yes. You manage every branch from one account, each with its own groups, captains and schedules, and switch between branches in one click.

items.q: Can I give my staff limited access?
items.a: Yes. The owner is the academy's admin and can add moderators, choosing exactly what each one can see and do, and which branch they work in.

items.q: Can I track income and expenses per branch?
items.a: Yes. The finance section shows income, expenses and net for each branch, including subscriptions and coach payroll.
Parents get their own portal showing their child's schedule, attendance and payment receipts.
Yes. Yallacademy is fully bilingual in Arabic and English, including right-to-left layout.

items.q: How is our academy's data protected?
items.a: Every academy's data is stored separately from other academies at the database level, and each user only sees what their role allows.
Book a demo or message us on WhatsApp. We set up your academy and help you import your existing data.
We're launching in Egypt and the Arab world first. Yallacademy runs in the browser, so it works anywhere with an internet connection.
